scope_notes.label: Modern regional mean versus historical surface assessment
scope_notes.source_locator: Introduction, section 3.1, Table 1, Table 3 (PDF page 15), seasonal discussion/Fig. 11 and Conclusions
scope_notes.summary: Modern observations support mean northward flow at 26.5 N, distinct from the older northern surface-flow assessment. Neither study defines whole-current endpoint coordinates. Table 3 gives a 49.4 km coast-to-site-B transport integration span, not current width; instrument positions are not along-current endpoints. Weak August-September transport maximum does not establish seasonal route geometry.
